description: Twenty-five rings, a giant carousel, bumper brawls and banana-dropping balloons. Gold in five minutes.
Fifteen treasure chests in a two-story dungeon maze. Lava pits, jail cells and giant snapping traps. Gold in two and a half minutes.
Race across colored tiles above a lava lake, dodge snapping dinosaurs, and jump the slime pit before climbing to the checkered finish.
Drop down a striped tower ramp, pass a red wyvern on the stacked causeway, and jump the slime before the raptor finish.
Race beneath five balloons, thread the yellow jaws and blue tile, then time the lime dinosaur's snap before the checkered transporter.
Dodge rising screws, jump a timed eruption, pick the safe gate and outrun the drill tank and crusher claw before the slime detour.
Ride a guided amber pipe onto the purple causeway, duck under twin silver overpasses, and jump the slime before the checkered finish.
Start atop the fireplace, race a tabletop obstacle course, ride the chair bridge onto the piano keys, and finish through the giant ring.
Race the Halloween toy track: yellow straight, junction bend, blue slide, slime jump and orange loop turn to the finish ring.
